name: Sign Rank
definition: The **sign rank** of a sign matrix $S$ is the least rank of a real matrix $M$ whose sign pattern is $S$.
graph_summary: The smallest real rank realizing the incidence sign pattern.
origin_references: This formulation and its connection with VC dimension are recorded in \cite{alon2016sign}.

monotonic.proof: The incidence sign matrix of a subfamily is obtained by deleting rows.  Restricting any real sign realization to those rows cannot increase its rank.

p_monotonic.proof: The incidence sign matrix after a coordinate projection is obtained by deleting columns.  Restricting a real sign realization to those columns cannot increase its rank.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, being monotonic under both subfamilies and projections is doubly monotonic.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection; hence doubly monotonicity implies c-monotonicity.
